```bash
from Crypto.Util.number import inverse, long_to_bytes
import codecs
def rsa_decrypt(n, p, q, e, c):
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = inverse(e, phi)
m = pow(c, d, n)
print("m :", m)
m_decode = long_to_bytes(m)
return m_decode
e = 0x10001
flag1 = rsa_decrypt(n1, p, q, e, c1)
print(flag1)
```

```bash
from factordb.factordb import FactorDB
n1_factor = FactorDB(n1)
if (n1_factor.connect().status_code == 200):
n1_factor = n1_factor.get_factor_list()
p, q = n1_factor[0], n1_factor[1]
p, q, p * q == n1

from Crypto.Util.number import inverse, long_to_bytes
import codecs
def rsa_decrypt(n, p, q, e, c):
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = inverse(e, phi)
m = pow(c, d, n)
print("m :", m)
m_decode = long_to_bytes(m)
return m_decode
e = 0x10001
flag1 = rsa_decrypt(n1, p, q, e, c1)
print(flag1)

n2 = x % n1
print(n2)
y = n2 // p
flag2 = rsa_decrypt(n2, p, y, e, c2)
print(flag2)

flag = flag1 + flag2
print(flag)
```
